title: Exact RML-D0 fluid/thermal CPU instrument v2
summary: Implement only the corrected RML-D0-FT-B-V1 CPU reference instrument in Candidate B, beginning with exhaustive micro-goldens and proceeding to four-pair then 64-pair conformance only when every prior gate passes. No model, GPU, learned-memory, benchmark, or paper claim is in scope.
system_thesis: Before testing whether sleep-compiled experiential memory improves later action, establish an exact action-first lifetime instrument whose legal public history closes connected and prospective targets, whose target-only shortcuts do not, and whose evaluation cannot mutate the life.

context_files.purpose: Verbatim current owner directive to continue autonomously and use compute without another pause.
Exact requested CPU-only authority and forbidden scope.
Normative corrected world, target, controller, leakage, isolation, and resource design.
Independent finite constructibility audit that rejected Candidate A and specified necessary repairs.
Independent methods audit covering twins, selection, Bayes, leakage, necessity, and resource defects.
Independent paper-level claim and post-D0 baseline audit.
Predecessor consensus requiring an exact CPU-only D0 repair before any model work.

nodes.before: The RML design has no constructible implemented CPU reference instrument.
nodes.after: A deterministic fluid/thermal action world implements Candidate B with public source lives, counterfactual twins, N/O/J/P targets, R diagnostics, exact controllers, leakage probes, certificates, isolation, and bounded artifacts.
nodes.rationale: Model experiments are uninterpretable until the benchmark itself has certified headroom and no target shortcut.

edges.after: Stage A may release the immutable four-pair Stage B inputs; only a fully passing Stage B maxima-based resource projection may release the 64-pair CPU gate. Every transition fails closed and cannot change filters, worlds, targets, or thresholds.
edges.rationale: Separate mathematical constructibility from production feasibility without using a passing subset to curate the gate.

loops.before: No exact RML CPU validation loop exists.
loops.after: Generate sealed finite tapes and worlds, execute the fixed public source schedule, commit prospective schemas before confirming events, build pair-common targets, run exact oracle/Bayes/probe/certificate controllers in disposable clones, compare run/skip suffixes, and seal one fail-closed report.
loops.trigger: Exact Candidate B bytes and this CPU-only scope are bound.
reads: offline hidden truth for environment, certifier, and scorer only
writes: Stage A and Stage B resource receipts
loops.stop_condition: Stop on the first schema, constructibility, leakage, necessity, chronology, isolation, Bayes, or resource failure; a pass stops at CPU instrument conformance and cannot launch model or GPU work.
loops.rationale: Make every downstream learning result conditional on an exact, nonleaking, bounded measurement instrument.

claims.after: A pass may establish only deterministic conformance of one finite CPU instrument: nonempty twin targets, legal-history headroom, bounded no-life shortcuts, connected J, grammar-conditioned P, causal-era growth, exact replay, and evaluation isolation.
claims.evidence_needed: All registered Candidate B Stage A, Stage B, and 64-pair CPU gates must pass on immutable inputs within resource ceilings.

cells.reason: The environment and generators create ordinary public records.
Controllers receive only their registered public projections.
Offline audit replays and scores the same public bytes.
Exclusive generators consume their own sealed tape cursors and emit only public products.
Legal and no-life controllers integrate the declared prior and never inspect the realized ledger or receipts.
Terminal audit verifies selection, chronology, and exact replay after decisions seal.
The environment applies hidden transitions but public scheduling and targets cannot inspect scores or proofs.
LH, PROGRAM, SCHEMA, BAYES, and leakage probes receive only their registered information; hidden-world solve is an offline ceiling.
The certifier and scorer require hidden truth but cannot write to source or evaluation state.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaustively run 16 target twins, 8 bridges, 4 valve-balance cases, P four-way completions, canonical records, and state-transition goldens.
acceptance_tests.expected: All target pairs are disjoint and depth-nine solvable on both twins; bridge outcomes swap; action-only balance posterior is uniform; P atoms-only value is exactly 1/4.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The world or twin construction is empty, ambiguous, or leaks the omitted valve through balance actions.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate exact K0-K3 prefixes, schema seals/appends, target kernels, accepted-deck Bayes-N, all registered projections, binding/twin controls, and scorer-tainted positive controls.
acceptance_tests.expected: Source events [123,250,500,996], mappings [36,71,142,285], exact BE equality; all shortcut/probe means <=.35 and p90 <=.45; answer injections equal 1.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Growth is padding, prediction is retrospective, selection leaks, or target-visible information closes the task.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run LH/PROGRAM/SCHEMA and hidden ceilings plus exact J old-transform cuts and P atoms-only/witnessed-graph ablations on every immutable target.
acceptance_tests.expected: Legal-history and applicable program/schema controllers score 1; every J cut scores 0; P graph scores 1/4 while schema/program score 1.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The target lacks connected/prospective necessity or sufficient legal history cannot solve it.

acceptance_tests.setup: Execute evaluation-run and evaluation-skip forks from every cut using read-only snapshots, disposable workspaces, independent cursors, and canaries.
acceptance_tests.expected: Source state, events, suffixes, future handles/targets, commitments/status, cursors, and final hashes match exactly; no capability or cross-life canary fires.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Evaluation teaches, mutates, or contaminates the lifetime.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run Stage A, immutable four-pair Stage B, maxima-based extrapolation, and conditional 64-pair gate under Candidate B ceilings; audit final labels and forbidden calls.
acceptance_tests.expected: All CPU limits pass with declared margin; model/network/GPU calls are zero; every output is labeled CPU instrument conformance only.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Exact inference is infeasible at registered scale or engineering evidence is promoted into a learning/paper claim.
